title: Genre revenue
statementMd:
Total gross per genre (ignoring unknown grosses), biggest first.

Expected columns: `genre`, `total_gross`.

Tables: `movies`, `directors`, `reviews`.

**Row order matters** for this problem.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT genre, SUM(gross_millions) AS total_gross FROM movies GROUP BY genre ORDER BY total_gross DESC;
```
